acceptance.summary: NoiseLab now versions the Cargo 1.89 dependency graph, runs Rust checks with --locked, and validates the checked-in lockfile in the smoke provenance bundle.
verified_properties: Cargo.lock is generated by Cargo 1.89.0 and records registry checksums plus pinned SciRust and FLAT-ATTENTION git revisions.
CI cargo check, clippy and test all use --locked.
Research report smoke contracts copy the checked-in lockfile and run cargo metadata --locked without regenerating it.
Documentation describes the checked-in lockfile as the graph used by the smoke workflow.
AGENTS.md, the off-main ecosystem roadmap, PolyForm license and required notices were read; no protocol or license boundary changed.
limitations: The lockfile freezes the graph for this source revision; intentional future dependency updates still require review and a new lockfile.
CI runs on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu and does not qualify other operating systems or hardware.

review.correction: Removed cargo generate-lockfile from research smoke, consumed the checked-in lockfile directly, and updated the provenance documentation.

counting.rule: Count the technical PR exactly once; tracker commits are not counted.
